PROGRAM zreg_screen_form_dynpro.
DATA gv_counter TYPE i VALUE 1.
DATA gv_secret TYPE c LENGTH 10.
MODULE status_0100 OUTPUT.
  PERFORM hide_secret.
ENDMODULE.
MODULE user_command_0100 INPUT.
  gv_counter = gv_counter + 1.
ENDMODULE.
FORM hide_secret.
  LOOP AT SCREEN.
    IF screen-group1 = 'OFF'.
      screen-active = '0'.
      MODIFY SCREEN.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.
ENDFORM.
